run_ProfilingInterpreter: run a ProfilingInterpreter on a GraphModule to profile node-level memory and runtime on CUDA
summary_ProfilingInterpreter: generate a pandas DataFrame summary of per-node runtime and memory stats from a ProfilingInterpreter
get_max_mem_fragmentation_ProfilingInter: get the maximum memory fragmentation ratio from a ProfilingInterpreter after running a profiled model
get_peak_reserved_bytes_ProfilingInterpr: get the peak reserved GPU memory bytes from a ProfilingInterpreter after profiling a model
get_allocated_mem_at_peak_ProfilingInter: get the allocated memory at peak reservation from a ProfilingInterpreter after profiling a model
